observation.command: echo "=== dl.min.io ==="; timeout 30 curl -sSI https://dl.min.io/server/minio/release/linux-amd64/minio 2>&1 | head -5; echo "=== chainguard minio-client shell ==="; docker run --rm --entrypoint /bin/sh chainguard/minio-client:latest -c 'command -v mc; command -v curl; echo ok' 2>&1 | head; echo "=== minio-client entrypoint ==="; docker inspect chainguard/minio-client:latest --format '{{.Config.Entrypoint}}|{{.Config.Cmd}}|{{.Config.User}}'
